snp1.1:1.1: Yo uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ visataṃ sappavisaṃ va osadhehi, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ urago jiṇṇam iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
snp1.1:16.1: Yassa vanathajā na santi keci vinibandhāya bhavāya hetukappā, so bhikkhu . . . || || Yo nīvaraṇe pahāya pañca anigho tiṇṇakathaṃkatho
snp1.1:17.1: visallo, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ urago jiṇṇam iva tacaṃ purāṇan ti || || URAGASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
